llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward legal case-briefing prompt with no code execution, credential use, persistence, or hidden data handling.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, README, and SKILL instructions align: collect a judicial opinion, confirm source details, and draft an IRAC case brief while flagging uncertainty.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are bounded to user-supplied case material, require confirmation before drafting, prohibit invented facts or legal advice, and include accuracy checks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only Markdown files, no executable scripts, no dependencies, and hashes match the metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may process legal opinions and matter-reading context, which can include sensitive information, but this is disclosed and proportionate to the drafting purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, local file access, credential access, network calls, or privilege requests are present; the only external link is a feedback issue/PR link.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Safe to install for drafting study or work case briefs from supplied opinions. Users should still avoid pasting confidential client-identifying details unless necessary, verify quotations and citations against the official reporter, and remember the output is not legal advice.
